mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", phase_id AS "phaseId", ability_id AS "abilityId", phase_order AS "phaseOrder", phase_type_id AS "phaseTypeId", duration_formula_key AS "durationFormulaKey", interruptible AS interruptible, change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_phases WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND phase_id = #{phaseId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.ability_phases (game_id, phase_id, ability_id, phase_order, phase_type_id, duration_formula_key, interruptible, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{phaseId}, #{abilityId}, #{phaseOrder}, #{phaseTypeId}, #{durationFormulaKey}, #{interruptible}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, phase_id) DO UPDATE SET ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, phase_order = EXCLUDED.phase_order, phase_type_id = EXCLUDED.phase_type_id, duration_formula_key = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_key, interruptible = EXCLUDED.interruptible, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", phase_id AS "phaseId", ability_id AS "abilityId", phase_order AS "phaseOrder", phase_type_id AS "phaseTypeId", duration_formula_key AS "durationFormulaKey", interruptible AS interruptible, change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_phases WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, phase_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ability_phases_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, phase_id, ability_id, phase_order, phase_type_id, duration_formula_key, interruptible ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, phase_id, ability_id, phase_order, phase_type_id, duration_formula_key, interruptible FROM public.ability_phases WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, phase_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, phase_order = EXCLUDED.phase_order, phase_type_id = EXCLUDED.phase_type_id, duration_formula_key = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_key, interruptible = EXCLUDED.interruptible
